notes: Background: product analytics SaaS, in-app assistant to help users interpret dashboards and trigger workflows (create ticket, run cohort) - heavy multi-step agents
Primary ask: latency SLO for initial response 120-200ms p95, streaming important for UX (progressive replies), sustained throughput ~40 rps during peak
Agent pattern: user intent -> retrieval over internal docs + vector search -> candidate actions (API calls) -> confirm & execute. Must be able to abort/rollback action steps.

POC findings: Hosted API streaming works well for first-token latency, but tool-call reliability depends on connector timeout behavior; observed ~2-4% of agent runs where external API hung and Redwood fallback didn't trigger quickly enough
Customer quote: 'We can't have the agent hang waiting on an external vendor — need deterministic fallbacks and retry semantics for tool calls.'
They want explicit control over tool-call timeout (per-tool), retry policy, and a guaranteed fast-fail path that returns a retrieval-only answer if an action cannot complete within Xs.

Interest in Dedicated: predictable tail latency and isolated capacity for peak days, plus easier security posture (VPC/KMS). Finance sensitive to monthly commit size — asked for graduated pilot pricing.
Security: require SSO/SAML, audit logs for each tool call and action execution, and confirmation that KMS integration supports key rotation and BYOK in Dedicated/private

Integration notes: willing to use Redwood SDKs for streaming + function-calls; backend search uses Elastic + vector store currently; need guidance on batching/cache settings to reduce token cost and preserve SLOs
Next POC steps: adjust tool-call timeout to 3s, add 2-stage fallback (shorter model + no-action reply), measure failed-action rate over next 5k agent runs; SE to deliver config template by 2026-03-10
